g.text: K4.2: both matmuls on the tensor cores, P never leaves the registers
acc_pv: 64 x d / 128 FP32 per thread,
rescaled by exp(m_old - m_new) each tile,
divided by l once at the end
who holds what in a 64 x 64 accumulator (PTX wgmma D fragment layout)
thread t of a warp holds rows 16w + t/4 and 16w + t/4 + 8, columns 8i + 2(t%4) and 8i + 2(t%4) + 1 for i = 0..7: 32 values.
the four lanes with equal t/4 share a row, so the row max and row sum are reduced across them with two shuffles.
